mentions.name: Beacon
mentions.description: A mobile app for finding a friend who is free to talk right now. Users send a beacon to a group, everyone gets a gentle ping, and the first person to answer is connected for a one-on-one call while the other signals drop silently. Missed beacons aren't logged, so there's no pressure to answer or return calls.
mentions.problem: Instantly answering "which friend is free to talk right now?" without the pressure of unanswered calls or having to return calls.
mentions.audience: Best used with 4+ friends/family you'd like to chat with more; the author already has dozens of connections in the app.
mentions.source_excerpt: I’ve been working on Beacon, which just got approved on the App Store! It’s a mobile app to instantly answer “which friend is free to talk right now?” and summon them in a single tap.

mentions.name: Beacon
mentions.description: A mobile app that answers "which friend is free to talk right now?" by sending a one-to-many call to a group: everyone is rung at the same time, the first person to answer gets connected for a one-to-one call, and everyone else's signal drops silently. There are no missed calls and no pressure to answer, with in-app settings for quiet hours. Available in beta on iOS via TestFlight and on Android.
mentions.problem: People don't know which friend is free to talk right now, and ordinary calls create missed calls and pressure to answer, especially since most people keep their phones on silent.
mentions.audience: People who like phone calls, including both introverts and extroverts who wish they had more of them
